title: named relatives created from a primary record
line: once the mother is accepted on her son's Kentucky death record, the son the record states she bore, whom nobody in the tree fits, is created by the rule with the record's facts and the child link accepted and enters the plan, while the man the page files as her husband, FamilySearch's own grouping around a relative of the record's subject, is not taken through the link the file claims; a creation taken back is taken again and links the same person, never a second one

steps.say: the death record naming her as the deceased's mother, attached on the owner's word as hers

expect.why: a card for the person it was attached for; the son and the husband the page files beside her wait on her

steps.say: she is accepted by the owner: the record's relatives follow at once

expect.why: a son nobody fits, whom the T2 death record states she bore, is created by the rule, recorded as the rule with its reason
the man the page files as her husband is put to the tree's own husband, a card for the owner

why.has: its indexer's, not the record's own statement

expect.why: the page's own person is a relative of the record's subject: the son's row is the record's statement, her husband FamilySearch's grouping around her (the death record names him the son's father, never her husband), so the claimed route does not take him
one person created, the proposal remembering him
his name, death and parents link accepted from the record, which states the parents itself
the created person enters the plan

steps.say: the rule re-examines: its decisions stand
the rule's creation taken back: his link undecided, the person row stays
reconsider takes the card again and links the same person, no second one
